mobbin:ee3075cd-af6e-4a12-b483-b0045f9f0.summary: From the hiring Benefits step, admin opens Equipment, adds a device (type, model, serial, condition, notes) when inventory is empty, and ends with the laptop assigned and status Pending shipping.
steal: When nothing can be assigned, the screen says 'There are no devices to be assigned from your inventory' and 'Add New' is the only way forward (screen 3).
The device form requires Model and Serial/Unique ID with character limits, makes Condition optional, and notes 'These notes are shared with your worker.' (screen 5).
After assign, the item card shows type, model, and serial, Status = Pending shipping, and that shipping is marked later from the device overview (screen 6).
Continue stays disabled until a device is selected (screen 3).
avoid: Full item creation sits inside an unrelated multi-step hire form; create and assign should be reachable from Assets itself, not only during first-time setup.
mobbin:ee3075cd-af6e-4a12-b483-b0045f9f0.fit: Inventory: extends items and manual check-out with typed assets that have serial and condition, assign-to-person, and a logistics status for out for delivery between storage and borrower.

mobbin:58cd5280-42c1-4bea-8d20-635fcbf3b.summary: Assets list with a location-status overview opens a ThinkPad quick view: Tracking (In storage, intake date, no service) then Asset details (IDs, condition, purchase and end-of-life).
steal: The location overview bar shows With worker / In transit / In storage / Write off counts across total inventory (screen 1).
List actions include 'Bulk import' and Add asset, filters for Worker, storage locations, and Category, and Quick view per row (screen 1).
The Tracking tab shows location label In storage, named storage site, Storage intake date, and empty service offers send to storage, assign, or retire (screen 2).
Asset details show Asset ID and Serial you can duplicate to the clipboard, Condition, Purchase date, and End of life date even when Not specified (screen 3).
mobbin:58cd5280-42c1-4bea-8d20-635fcbf3b.fit: Inventory: strong items pattern for an asset registry: status distribution, quick panel with tracking versus identity, and lifecycle dates. Lighter than Enterprise counting, richer than a flat list.
